description: This file defines a utility function `shareBlobOnMobile` that enables sharing a Blob object as a file on mobile web applications. It performs a runtime check to ensure it is used within a native mobile web context, converts the Blob to a base64 string, and then invokes a sharing method on the application's mobile device interface.

methods.name: shareBlobOnMobile
methods.description: Async function that shares a Blob object as a file on native mobile webview after converting it to base64 and checking the application context.

ctags.name: shareBlobOnMobile
ctags.pattern: /^export const shareBlobOnMobile = async (application: WebApplication, blob: Blob, filename: strin/
